policy: Dependency-audit exceptions (scripts/lib.mjs evaluateAudit, docs/security/CI-CD-SECURITY.md). Only for advisories that affect development tooling alone; HIGH/CRITICAL in production dependencies always block. Each exception names one advisory id, has a reason, and expires within 90 days; the owner accepts it by committing this file. Remove an entry as soon as the advisory is fixed upstream.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS through crafted single-branch repeated extglobs. picomatch is reached only through development tooling (eslint/typescript-eslint, vite/vitest via tinyglobby and fdir), which matches glob patterns written by the developers in configuration files; no untrusted pattern reaches it. Not in the production dependency tree (pnpm audit --prod: no known vulnerabilities). No patched version published (latest 4.0.7).

ReDoS via globparts amplification in eslint/typescript-eslint (development tooling only, developer-written patterns). Moderate: reported, not blocking; listed so every accepted advisory is in one place.
